study type: critical review with preliminary recommendations and registry establishment
cohort: The study focuses on developing guidance for pregnant women infected with SARS-CoV-2, drawing insights from a systematic review of 2567 pregnant women and non-pregnant populations.
finding: Specific hemostatic issues during pregnancy in the context of COVID-19 were highlighted, leading to the development of preliminary recommendations for the care of COVID-19-affected pregnant women with coagulopathy or thrombotic complications.
